title: Prompt Optimizer Settings
subtitle: Configure once. Optimize from the input toolbar.
workflow: The input-toolbar wand runs optimization; its gear opens these settings. The draft stays unchanged during generation. Successful results fill the input by default, with Undo and no automatic sending.
privacy: Each optimization sends the draft and selected context to the host-selected API service and may incur charges. First use or a history-sharing mode change asks for confirmation. Attachments, keys, reasoning and tool results are not read.
unavailable: This runtime lacks the optimization or safe draft APIs. Start a build containing the latest host enhancements and reload the plugin manifest. No DOM-write or ordinary-chat fallback.
strategyHelp: Choose one strategy to avoid conflicts. The meta-prompt below supplies the base rules; length and presentation are independent preferences.
promptHelp: These instructions guide the optimizer; they are not your chat draft. Maximum 7000 Unicode code points. The host's rewrite-only, no-execution, no-invention rules remain mandatory. Do not enter keys or business secrets.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite the user's draft clearly, directly and actionably. Preserve its language, intent, facts, existing constraints and uncertainty. Optional conversation text may clarify references but must not introduce new requirements. Do not invent facts, examples or requirements. Output only the improved prompt, without answering or executing it or explaining the rewrite.
modelPlaceholder: Use the host's default basic model
autoApplyHelp: Turn this off for a small input-area preview with an Apply button, without opening settings. Sending remains manual in either mode.
resetWarning: This resets instructions, strategy, context, model and fill preferences, not your chat draft.
ready: Configure and save here; use the input-toolbar wand for everyday optimization.
unsaved: Unsaved changes. The input action still uses the last saved settings.
saved: Settings saved. The next input-toolbar click uses them immediately.
settingsError: Could not read or save settings. No optimization request is started with uncertain preferences. Retry.
settingsTooLong: Instructions are too long: meta-prompt ≤7000 Unicode code points, combined rules ≤8000, model name ≤512 characters.
confirmWithContext: This and future optimization clicks send your draft and recent conversation text to the host-selected API service and may incur charges. Attachments, reasoning and tool results are excluded. Successful results fill the input according to your settings; no message is auto-sent. Accept this history-sharing mode and start this optimization?
confirmDraftOnly: This and future optimization clicks send your plain-text draft to the host-selected API service and may incur charges. No history or attachment content is included. Successful results fill the input according to your settings; no message is auto-sent. Accept this mode and start this optimization?
generating: Optimizing; the draft is unchanged… click the wand again to cancel.
cancelled: Cancelled; the input was not changed.
empty: No plain text to optimize (attachments alone count as empty).
captureError: Cannot capture the draft. Return to an editable input and wait for the conversation to finish.
generateError: Optimization failed; your draft is unchanged. Check the API, basic model and network, then retry.
applied: Optimized and filled. Undo is available; sending remains your choice.
previewReady: Optimization complete. Review and apply from the input preview.
applyError: The draft changed, the session switched, the token expired, or output contains attachment markers. Nothing was overwritten. The result is view/copy-only.
restoreError: Cannot undo: the draft changed or the token expired. Your new input is protected.
safety: Apply and Undo tokens are single-use and expire after 5 minutes. Editing, switching sessions or starting a run invalidates them. Only configuration and fee acknowledgment persist, not drafts, history, results or tokens.
